limitations: Source-only inventory; no BWH database file, production rows, WAL, migration ledger contents, live table presence, row counts, database size or runtime workload were inspected.
The 70/820 integrated set includes one conditional legacy Payment archive and two feature-gated Ads Consent tables; actual production presence is NOT_OBSERVED.

The core matrix and companion dossier evidence use historical source cut 3768644aa33a01af55d5da6444acebe16f78fd64; table/column names were cross-checked against source modules read from current master.

The 18 original checksums are historical G1-28 runtime recomputations with current-head diff review; not a full 19/19 current-head runtime re-execution. Plan C checksum is independently recomputed from current source.
Welcome Bonus is represented in terminal 21-column form; commercial_model existed in v1 and was removed by the promotion migration.
The legacy archive is conditional on exact legacy schema fingerprint; D1 should construct final archive shape directly rather than replay the RENAME.
FK edges represent declared SQL foreign keys only. Logical references without FK declarations are not inferred.
Referral's ten generated immutable triggers are enumerated from its source generation rule; Plan C is a same-name replacement; SQLite autoindexes are excluded.
